event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT South of Tanjung Ramunia, Johor, (Malaysia), in the westbound lane of the TSS Malaysia 01° 18.59' N

sources.title: Piracy monthly report April 2024
sources.text: While the tug boat towing barge was underway, the master noticed a sampan alongside the barge. Three perpetrators were seen leaving the barge with some copper coils and fibre boards. The crew was mustered and accounted for. The crew was not injured. The tug boat and barge last port of call was Bintulu, Sarawak, East Malaysia and was bound for Singapore Pilot Eastern Boarding Ground “A”.
